SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE

Welcome to the meeting of the Senior Services Committee. Meetings are open to the public and held at the Adult Recreation Center at 201 E Colorado Street, Glendale,
CA 91205. Meeting minutes will be available for viewing on the City Website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/community-services-
parks/programs-services/senior-programs-services/senior-services-committee. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please
contact (818) 548-3715 during regular business hours.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES DURING THE MEETING.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon
request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA
91206.

  MEETING AGENDA
  Thursday, February 28, 2019, 3:00 p.m.
  Adult Recreation Center, 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205

1.  ROLL CALL
  A. Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the February 28, 2019,
  quarterly meeting of the Senior Services Committee was posted on or before Monday, February

2.  MINUTES
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the November 15, 2018, Senior Services Committee Meeting.

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS

  and Senior Services Programs.

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5) minutes. The
  Committee may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The Director or designee
  may refer the matter to the proper section for investigation and report.

5.  Reports – Information Only
  A. Report regarding upcoming Winter/Spring 2019 Senior Programs and Events.

6.  Action Items
  A. Report regarding Key Recommendation #3 - development of intra-agency plan with Public Safety
  to educate seniors on Emergency Preparedness
  1.  Presentation on Emergency Preparedness by City’s Fire Department, Fire Captain Andrew
  Gano
  2.  Motion to provide direction to staff regarding development of an intra-agency plan to educate
  seniors on Emergency Preparedness.
  B. Report regarding Key Recommendation #4 - development and training on healthcare and caregiver
  training/support
  1.  Motion to provide direction to staff regarding development and training on healthcare and
  caregiver training/support
  C. Report regarding Key Recommendation #5 - working with Senior Services Network of Stakeholders

minutes_text:
SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
  Thursday, February 28, 2019, 3:00 p.m.
  Adult Recreation Center, 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205

1.  ROLL CALL

  The meeting was called to order at 3:00 p.m.

  Present: Committee Members Aintablian, Filipian, Gano, Levee, Nazarians, Pierce, Varraveto, Young.
  Absent: Committee Members Barrios, Gonzalez, Panchal, Voskanian, Koszis
  Staff:  Aleksanian, Kavarian, Isayan

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda. Ms. Isayan reported that the Agenda for the
  February 28, 2019, quarterly meeting of the Senior Services Committee was posted on or before
  Monday, February 25, 2019, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2.  MINUTES
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the November 15, 2018, Senior Services Committee Meeting

  A motion was made to approve the minutes of the November 15, 2018, Senior Services
  Committee meeting as written.

  Moved: Nazarian  Second: Filipian
  Unanimous Consensus (Motion Carried)

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  A. Introduction of Aylin Isayan, Community Services Supervisor overseeing Adult Recreation Center
  and Senior Services programs.

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  None

5.  Reports – Information Only
  A. Quarterly Activity Report regarding Senior Programs and Events Update for Winter/Spring 2019.

  Ms. Kavarian introduced Aylin Isayan Community Services Supervisor with the City’s Community
  Services & Parks Department, who reported on various events and programs offered in Winter and
  Spring 2019.

6.  Action Items
  A.  Report regarding Key Recommendation #3- development of intra-agency plan with Public Safety to
  educate seniors on Emergency preparedness.
  1.  Presentation on Emergency Preparedness by City’s Fire Department, Fire Captain Andrew
  Gano

  1
   Captain Gano presented a PowerPoint on the 12 Steps of Preparedness. Committee members
  asked numerous questions about how seniors can prepare each month. Chair Levee
  suggested providing only the most important items on a list for seniors, so as to not overwhelm
  them. Committee members asked questions about Glendale’s emergency plan as it relates to
  the recent fires and how people can be notified of evacuations. President Levee suggested
  coming up with training targeting the senior population.

  2.  Motion to provide direction to staff regarding development of an intra-agency plan to educate
  seniors on Emergency Preparedness.

  The Committee discussed how to coordinate a citywide event on Emergency Preparedness,
  an “intergenerational disaster workshop” to include seniors and their families. Committee
  members expressed concern that a hospital venue could deter people from attending,
  discussed the issue of North Glendale and South Glendale seniors finding transportation to
  attend, and Committee Member Pierce suggested having a monthly workshop that provides
  attendees kits utilizing the guidelines in Captain Gano’s presentation. Committee Member
  Nazarians stated he would follow up with Home Fit program from AARP and bring the
  information back to the Committee. Committee Member Aintablian expressed concern about
  translation being available for Spanish and Armenian speaking attendees. Committee Member
  Gano suggested not to hold the event on the date of the Great American Shake Out because
  of previously scheduled events by the Fire Department. Staff mentioned the Civic Auditorium
  as a potential venue.

  A motion was made directing staff to look for available dates and venues in the month of
  October to hold an Emergency Preparedness event.

  Moved: Young  Second: Pierce
  Unanimous Consensus (Motion Carried)

  B.  Report regarding Key Recommendation #4 - development and training on healthcare and caregiver
  training/support

  Chair Levee asked to postpone this item to the next meeting of the Senior Services Committee

  C.  Report regarding Key Recommendation #5 - working with Senior Services Network of Stakeholders
  to promote Senior Safety.

  Chair Levee asked to postpone this item to the next meeting of the Senior Services Committee.

7.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
  Ms. Kavarian invited the Committee to attend the Proclamation of Older Americans Month in May and
  said she would send an invitation informing them of the date.

8.  ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 4:15 p.m.
